title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for designing and implementing robust data pipelines. Must maintain high data quality and security in cloud environments, automating tasks with Python and Bash scripting, and continuously research new technologies to enhance scalability. This role focuses on the development and implementation of data engineering solutions that enhance data warehousing capabilities and maintain legacy and new systems.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement data pipelines to move and transform data from various sources into cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using tools such as Fivetran, Matillion, SSIS, SSAS, SSRSand Snowflake Dataflow on AWS.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval by designing and implementing data partitioning, indexing, and compression strategies.
  • Build and maintain data processing infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Collaborate with business and analysts to ensure data quality, accuracy, and availability for analysis and reporting.
  • Manage and lead Complex System Design, Integration and Development.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Implement security and access controls to protect sensitive data in cloud-based environments.
  • Automate data processing tasks using scripting languages such as Python or Bash
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools to improve data processing efficiency and scalability.
  • Mentor and train junior data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Computer Science, Engineering or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience developing, validating, and implementing data warehouses, data systems or cloud-based data solutions.
  • Experience in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing and legacy systems.
  • Experience with multiple data modeling approaches, SQL, and scripting programming languages like Python and PowerShell.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Good understanding of OLAP Cubes, Dimensional model.
  • Ability to lead and coach team members.
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder engagement abilities; driving results through innovation, process improvement and creativity.
  • Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of agile methodologies, QA practices and user experience, with strong digital & technical skills.
  • Experienced with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Lucid Chart;).
  • Strong understanding of databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, HANA, Snowflake.
  • Experience with traditional on-prem virtual and physical infrastructure, as well as cloud-based environments, preferably AWS.
  • Excellent understanding of Windows, and Linux based infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of various tools, open-source technologies, and cloud services

title: Legal Counsel - Corporate and Contracts
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry.   • Review, structure, draft and negotiate commercial agreements in a broad range of transactional disciplines, including marketing and services agreements, publisher agreements, production agreements, cobranding agreements, NDAs, and license agreements.

title: Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)
description:
Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)

Brazil

Duration: 1 Year + Possibility of extension

Full time - Onsite


Job Description


We're seeking an organized, proactive coordinator to support a co-managed data center migration from on-premises to the comanaged location. This role will partner with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to plan, track, and execute migration activities, while also supporting ongoing infrastructure and network operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and experienced in coordinating complex infrastructure projects across time zones.


  • Key Responsibilities Project coordination for data center migration:
  • Assist in developing and maintaining the migration project plan, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate discovery and inventory of applications, servers, storage, network devices, and interdependencies.
  • Support readiness assessments, migration runbooks, fallback plans, and post-migration validation.
  • Track risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID), and drive mitigation or escalation.
  • Schedule and facilitate migration waves, change windows, and cutover activities with cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain clear documentation, status reports, and decision logs.
  • Global stakeholder engagement:
  • Serve as a central point of contact across global infrastructure, network, security, application, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate with the co-managed data center provider at the comanaged location and relevant third-party vendors.
  • Organize and lead recurring standups, working sessions, and steering updates; capture and distribute minutes and action items.
  • Escalate blockers to the appropriate leadership and functional teams with context and recommended next steps.
  • Infrastructure and network support:
  • Support day-to-day infrastructure and network-related activities tied to the migration (e.g., change coordination, maintenance scheduling, access requests).
  • Coordinate network changes, including VLANs, routing updates, firewall rule requests, WAN/Internet transitions, and load balancer configurations as directed by SMEs.
  • Help track capacity planning inputs (compute, storage, network bandwidth) and ensure alignment with target-state designs.
  • Assist in validating connectivity, performance baselines, and post-migration health checks with monitoring teams.
  • Governance, compliance, and change management:
  • Ensure changes follow change control processes, maintenance windows, and communication protocols.
  • Coordinate audit-ready documentation for migrations, including approvals, test results, and backout plans.
  • Partner with security and compliance teams on control requirements, access provisioning, and data handling policies.
  • Cutover and hypercare support:
  • Coordinate pre-cutover checkpoints, go/no-go decisions, and stakeholder communications.
  • Track hypercare issues, triage to the right teams, and ensure timely resolution and handoff to steady-state operations.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to playbooks for subsequent migration waves.

Communication and reporting:

  • Maintain dashboards, trackers, and concise status updates for technical teams and leadership.
  • Provide clear escalation paths, SLAs/ETAs, and communication cadences across time zones.
  • Keep project artifacts current in the designated PM and documentation tools.
  • Vendor and contract coordination:
  • Liaise with co-location and managed service providers for circuit turn-ups, cross-connects, racking/stacking schedules, remote hands, and logistics.
  • Track vendor deliverables and dependencies; escalate variances proactively.
  • Logistics and asset coordination:
  • Support shipment, receiving, and chain-of-custody processes for hardware moves.
  • Coordinate decommissioning, data sanitization workflows, and disposal certificates for retired assets.
  • Quality and risk management:
  • Assist with test plans for application and infrastructure validation (connectivity, performance, failover).
  • Monitor risk indicators (timeline slippage, capacity shortfalls, change collisions) and raise timely alerts.


  • Preferred Qualifications Experience coordinating data center or large-scale infrastructure migrations in a co-managed or hybrid environment.
  • Familiarity with core infrastructure concepts: servers/virtualization, storage, networking (routing, switching, firewalls, load balancers), DNS, and monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with project coordination tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, or similar).
  • Strong meeting facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work across global time zones and manage competing priorities.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to disaster recovery planning, backup/restore coordination, and business continuity exercises.
  • Understanding of change management frameworks and ITIL concepts.
  • Experience with inventory discovery tools and CMDB hygiene efforts.

Success Indicators:

  • On-time delivery of migration milestones with minimal incidents.
  • Clear, consistent communication and timely escalation of risks/issues.
  • Accurate, audit-ready documentation and repeatable runbooks for each migration wave.
  • Smooth handoffs from project to operations and measurable reduction in post-migration issues.

title: Coordenador(a) de Torre de Controle de Operações (Control Tower)
description:
O Coordenador de Torre de Controle de Operações será responsável por garantir a governança e o atingimento dos indicadores-chave de performance (KPIs) de toda a cadeia operacional da Privalia. Essa posição atuará de forma transversal, conectando áreas como operações comerciais (planejamento de campanhas de flash sales ), S&OP, armazém, transportes, qualidade, gestão de estoques, logística reversa e demais times dentro da estrutura de operações.

O papel envolve ser os “olhos” da gestão em toda a operação, assegurando que os KPIs corretos estão sendo medidos em tempo real, antecipando riscos de ruptura, conduzindo rituais de alinhamento diário entre áreas e estruturando planos de ação que suportem a entrega de metas de custo, prazo e qualidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Governança e Monitoramento de KPIs:

  • Garantir que todos os indicadores de performance operacional estejam claramente definidos, medidos em tempo real e acompanhados com disciplina;
  • Produzir dashboards e relatórios de acompanhamento diário, semanal e mensal.

Gestão Interdepartamental

  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento entre áreas (revisões diárias, semanais, mensais), assegurando clareza sobre status, tendências e planos de ação;
  • Atuar como ponto focal da performance operacional, cobrando entregas e facilitando a resolução de problemas.

Antecipação de Rupturas e Planos de Ação

  • Identificar desvios e riscos operacionais antes que impactem os resultados;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar planos de correção com os responsáveis de cada área.

Inteligência de Dados e Análise Preditiva

  • Liderar a frente de inteligência de dados de operações, garantindo qualidade, integridade e disponibilidade das informações;
  • Desenvolver análises preditivas e uso de inteligência artificial para melhorar visibilidade, previsibilidade e eficiência operacional.

Qualidade Operacional

  • Acompanhar aderência aos processos, investigar causas de falhas e estruturar melhorias.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, revisões executivas e iniciativas de padronização de processos.



Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Logística ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação/MBA será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia em funções de control tower, gestão de operações, supply chain ou qualidade operacional .
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com domínio de ferramentas de BI (Power BI, SQL, Python, etc.) e conhecimento em estatística ou análise preditiva.
  • Experiência em condução de rituais de governança, acompanhamento de KPIs e gestão de planos de ação.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interdepartamental, com perfil de cobrança estruturada e colaborativa.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de gestão da qualidade operacional e performance será diferencial.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente desejável.


O que oferecemos?


Além de um clima descontraído, sem política de dress code e total open space , compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:


  • Assistência Médica - Saúde em primeiro lugar! Oferecemos um plano médico completo pra você e seus dependentes se sentirem cuidados e tranquilos.
  • Assistência Odontológica - Sorriso bonito e saudável? Temos! Com acesso fácil a cuidados odontológicos de qualidade.

  • Happy Day (folga no aniversário) - Seu dia, do seu jeito. Aqui, aniversário é com folga pra comemorar como quiser.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Trace Finance

Trace Finance empowers global payment enterprises to seamlessly move money across borders and access stablecoins with ease. With over $5 billion USD in processed volume, we provide the infrastructure that enables instant settlement, regulatory clarity, and best-in-class FX and crypto on/off ramps. We're building the future of cross-border payments and digital asset infrastructure.

The Role

We're seeking a talented mid-level Platform Engineer (DevOps Engineer) to join our infrastructure team. While we prefer candidates who can work from our office for better collaboration and team integration, we also offer remote work flexibility. You'll be instrumental in building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure and automation systems that power our global payment platform. This is an opportunity to work on mission-critical infrastructure that supports billions in transaction volume and ensures 24/7 availability for our financial services.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS to support high-volume financial transactions
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable software deployments
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent, reproducible environments
  • Deploy, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized workloads
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability
  • Automate operational tasks and improve deployment processes to increase team efficiency
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize application performance and reliability
  • Ensure security best practices across all infrastructure components
  • Participate in on-call rotation to maintain 24/7 system availability
  • Document infrastructure architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues in production environments
Requirements
  • 3-5 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles
  • Strong problem-solving skills and systematic approach to troubleshooting
  • Ability to work independently whether in office or remote settings
  • Passion for automation, reliability, and operational excellence
  • Interest in financial technology and innovation
  • PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) registration or willingness to obtain
Required Technical Skills
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Container Orchestration: Proven expertise with Kubernetes (deployment, scaling, troubleshooting)
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for managing cloud resources
  • CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Scripting: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages
  • Containerization: Solid understanding of Docker and container best practices
  • Networking: Understanding of networking concepts, load balancers, DNS, and security groups
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch
  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Basic English proficiency (required for documentation and team communication)
Nice-to-Have Technical Skills
  • Experience with microservices architecture and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Database administration experience (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis)
  • Message queue systems (AWS SNS, SQS, Kafka)
  • Security and compliance tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, security scanning)
  • Experience with financial systems and high-availability requirements
  • Advanced Kubernetes features (operators, custom resources, Helm)
  • GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Performance tuning and capacity planning
  • Cost optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure
  • Intermediate English proficiency
Essential Soft Skills
  • Proactive mindset - Identify potential issues before they become problems
  • Self-learner - Stay current with evolving DevOps tools and practices
  • Critical thinking - Analyze complex systems and design elegant solutions
  • Self-management - Prioritize work effectively and manage your time independently
  • Team collaboration - Work effectively with engineering teams across different time zones
  • Commitment - Dedicated to maintaining system reliability and meeting SLAs
  • Versatility - Adapt to new technologies and changing infrastructure needs
  • Communication - Clearly document and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
What We Offer
  • Flexible work arrangement (office preferred, remote possible)
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge fintech and blockchain infrastructure
  • Build and maintain systems that process billions in transaction volume
  • Collaborative, innovative team environment with strong engineering culture
  • Professional growth opportunities in cloud technologies and DevOps practices
  • Exposure to both traditional finance and cryptocurrency ecosystems
  • Impact the reliability and scalability of global payment infrastructure
  • Work with modern tools and technologies in a forward-thinking organization


Ready to build world-class infrastructure? Join us at Trace Finance and be part of the team that powers the future of cross-border transactions and digital assets.

title: Financial Controller - LATAM
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Seller Governance Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry.   • Regularly monitor and analyze seller violation data to identify anomalies and areas for policy improvement, and drive continuous enhancements.
  • Collect and address seller feedback, strengthen seller education and training, and foster strong relationships to promote transparency, trust, and accountability.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams to continuously optimize platform operations and governance mechanisms.


Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in business
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce, online marketplaces, and seller dynamics
  • Familiarity with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
  • Self-starter, a fast learner who has critical thinking
  • English is mandatory, Mandarin is a plus


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Consultor Desenvolvimento Produtos
description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!


Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!


Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse , junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!


DESCRIÇÃO DO TRABALHO

Estamos procurando um Consultor de Produtos Sênior para atuar com o desenvolvimento de produtos e assegurar alto retorno de investimento (ROI). O profissional deverá traduzir ideias em estratégias e recursos e acompanhar o desenvolvimento de produtos do início ao fim.

Um consultor de produtos sênior é um profissional que atua no desenvolvimento de projetos, identificando problemas, propondo soluções e gerenciando a relação com os departamentos do cliente. Desempenhando um papel extremamente ativo no desenvolvimento de um projeto: formulando hipóteses, propondo soluções aos problemas e executando demandas.

Para ser bem-sucedido nessa função, é preciso ser um líder perceptivo, criativo e capaz de resolver problemas. Se, além disso, você tiver uma competência excepcional para conhecer quais ideias terão ou não sucesso, gostaríamos de conhecê-lo.

Inglês e espanhol serão diferenciais importantes.


ATIVIDADES A SEREM EXECUTADAS:

  • Apoiar estudos e análises sobre criptoativos, stablecoins, CBDCs e tecnologias blockchain.
  • ·Contribuir com benchmarks, pesquisas de mercado e tendências regulatórias.
  • Participar da elaboração de documentos técnicos e apresentações para áreas internas.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, tecnologia e jurídico em iniciativas relacionadas a ativos digitais.
  • Monitorar KPIs e métricas de produtos digitais em desenvolvimento ou operação.

REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA INSCRIÇÃO:

  • Formação superior completa (preferencialmente em Economia, Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência prévia com criptoativos, blockchain ou produtos financeiros digitais.
  • Boa capacidade de análise e comunicação.
  • Conhecimento básico de regulação financeira e inovação tecnológica.

Atuação com desenvolvimento backend em Java, com domínio de boas práticas de engenharia de software. Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS), garantindo soluções com alta disponibilidade, segurança, resiliência e performance.

title: Estagiário de engenharia civil
description:
A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. Com mais de 11.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é projetar soluções seguras e inovadoras que aproximem pessoas, promovam inclusão social e facilitem o acesso ao emprego, à educação e ao lazer em todo o mundo.


Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. Estamos presentes em mais de 80 países, incluindo o Brasil, que conta com mais de 800 colaboradores.


No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias.


A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.


Para maiores informações acesse


Na SYSTRA, além de contribuir com conhecimento e ideias inovadoras, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time de referência global, conectado por um propósito comum: transformar a mobilidade com excelência, audácia e colaboração. Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.


A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Auxiliar no fornecimento e controle da elaboração de projetos executivos e estudos preliminares de infraestrutura, como obras viárias, estruturas e fundações;
  • Colaborar na análise e compatibilização de projetos de diferentes disciplinas (arquitetura, elétrica, hidráulica etc.);

  • Revisar e conferir memoriais, plantas e demais documentos técnicos, garantindo a conformidade com as normas e padrões requisitados;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios de acompanhamento do desenvolvimento dos projetos.

  • Cursando Engenharia Civil a partir do 4º Ano;
  • Conhecimento em AutoCad, Autodesk Civil 3D e Google Earth;

DIFERENCIAIS:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.

Buscamos uma profissional para atuar como Assistente de Atendimento ao Paciente, sendo responsável por oferecer uma experiência acolhedora, humanizada e organizada a cada paciente que passa pela clínica.

O foco principal não é a parte administrativa ou financeira, mas sim cuidar do paciente, garantindo que ele se sinta bem recebido, confortável e apoiado durante todas as etapas do seu tratamento.

  • Organização e proatividade para lidar com rotinas de atendimento e agendamento.

title: Solution Architect Specialist
description:
Job Title – Solution Architect Specialist

TITTLE: Solution Architect Specialist (D2)

Location: São Paulo – Villa Lobos

Flexible Working / Hybrid – Office and Remote combination


Why join BT International?

BT International is looking for an experienced Solution Architect Specialist to join our Customer Solutions & Design team. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in architecting complex, high-impact solutions for our global customers — and ensuring that what we sell is what we deliver, right the first time.


Why this role matters

As a Solution Architect Specialist, you’ll act as the trusted advisor for strategic customers, shaping innovative solutions across multiple technology domains — from networking and cloud to security, collaboration, and AI. You’ll be accountable for the end-to-end solution lifecycle, working closely with sales, delivery, and service teams to drive exceptional outcomes.

This is more than a technical role — it’s a leadership position where your expertise, collaboration, and commercial acumen will directly influence BT International’s growth and reputation.


What you’ll do

  • Lead solution architecture for complex, customized, multi-technology environments — ensuring they are technically sound, commercially viable, and executable.
  • Translate customer business requirements into fit-for-purpose, scalable solutions that balance feasibility, cost, and profitability.
  • Own the solution lifecycle across pre-sales, proposal development, and early delivery, ensuring alignment with scope, risk management, and governance standards.
  • Partner with sales teams to develop compelling proposals, statements of work, and customer contracts.
  • Represent BT in strategic customer meetings, presenting solutions with impact and confidence at executive level.
  • Collaborate with virtual cross-functional teams (sales, bid, product, delivery, and service design) to ensure end-to-end solution clarity and deliverability.
  • Assess and manage scope changes during delivery to maintain alignment with cost, time, and quality objectives.
  • Contribute to BT’s market leadership by developing reusable solution components and accelerators, and by staying ahead of emerging trends (e.g., AI, advanced cloud, and digital workplace solutions).

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience (10+ years) in pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex IT environments.
  • Track record of success in large, global sales opportunities, supporting revenue growth and delivery excellence.
  • Strong expertise in multi-domain solution design across:
  • Digital Infrastructure (Cloud, WAN, SDWAN, LAN, WiFi, Security)
  • Digital Workplace (Collaboration, Contact Centres)
  • Emerging technologies (AI, automation)
  • Skilled in proposal development, estimation, and scope definition, with the ability to identify risks and dependencies.
  • Strong commercial acumen — able to balance customer needs with business objectives, protect scope, and identify cross-sell/up-sell opportunities.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills; confident engaging with senior executives and simplifying complex concepts.
  • A leadership mindset: proactive, accountable, and able to guide cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • A continuous improvement approach: curious, innovative, and passionate about raising the bar in solution quality and delivery.


What you’ll get

  • The chance to work with a global portfolio of strategic customers.
  • A hybrid, flexible work environment.
  • Competitive package with opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • Be part of a team where things just work… Better on BT.

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*


Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Coordenador de Controladoria
description:
SOBRE O GROUPE SEB:

Nosso propósito é facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.

Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo.

Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.

Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas.

Identificou-se com nosso negócio e valores?

Então venha contribuir e deixar sua marca na história da SEB!


Missão:

Coordenar o processo de geração, análise e reporte de informações gerenciais da controladoria atendendo aos parâmetros do Grupo SEB, bem como análises de viabilidade financeira de projetos, visando contribuir para a apuração dos resultados corporativos e subsidiar o processo de tomada de decisões.


Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Coordenar o fluxo de informações internas, para que os relatórios solicitados pela matriz sejam devidamente preenchidos e enviados, no prazo estabelecido;
  • Receber os dados consolidados da matriz, formatar, analisar e reportá-los;
  • Administrar informações e prazos para a execução de orçamentos;
  • Elaborar e emitir relatórios internos sobre os resultados alcançados pela empresa (local e/ou consolidado);
  • Apoiar a Gerência de Controladoria na compilação das informações financeiras;
  • Elaborar e emitir apresentações e demonstrações que atendam às demandas da Gerência de Controladoria ou eventuais solicitações internacionais;
  • Criar e manter o cadastro de produtos que irão fazer parte do fluxo de informações do grupo;
  • Desenvolver sistemáticas apropriadas à elaboração do budget pelos diversos setores/usuários;
  • Coordenar junto aos demais departamentos da empresa as premissas, prazos e metas orçamentárias para que os orçamentos possam ser elaborados;
  • Efetuar cálculos específicos necessários para elaboração do orçamento;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de novos processos para atender às novas demandas de informações financeiras da empresa.


O que buscamos?

  • Formação superior, graduação em Administração de Empresas ou Economia.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em Controladoria Financeira ou atividades compatíveis;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (mínimo nível avançado)
  • Conhecimento em mercado de Câmbio e paridades monetárias;
  • Conhecimento em aplicativos de informática com conhecimentos avançados em Excel;
  • Conhecimento em métodos de custeio, normas e procedimentos contábeis;


Quais benefícios você encontrará na SEB?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

Assistência médica e odontológica, para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar.

Canal de apoio CARE (saúde emocional, social, legal e financeira); Para você cuidar da sua saúde: Emocional, Social, Legal e Financeira.

Parceria com Wellhub.

Flexibilidade e Qualidade de Vida :

Modelo híbrido;

Traje casual todos os dias;

Day off no seu aniversário! você poderá tirar um dia de folga e aproveitar com as pessoas que você considera importante!

VBET’s mission is to give our customers the best betting and gaming experience in a safe and secure environment.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Contract Manager (Legal) to take full ownership of our third-party vendor contracts. This operational role requires a pragmatic, hands-on professional who can quickly standardize our contracting process and mitigate commercial risks.

A Afetto Design, fundada em 2024, é uma marca de móveis e decoração infantil que acredita no design como ponte entre ideias inovadoras e experiências memoráveis. Posicionada entre o clássico e o contemporâneo, a empresa oferece peças cuidadosamente planejadas para acompanhar o desenvolvimento das crianças.

Com foco no protagonismo infantil, nossas coleções aliam estilo atemporal para adultos e diversão para as crianças, promovendo ambientes que inspiram criatividade. Afinal, o crescimento é uma jornada, e a Afetto está presente em cada passo!

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking (GTB)
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ; graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.


Learn more about us: nfq.es | LinkedIn NFQ

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)


Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

description:

title: Analista PCP Pl
description:

É com esse olhar que buscamos alguém para fazer parte do nosso time de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP): alguém que entenda de processos, valorize a organização e tenha paixão por transformar planejamento em eficiência real.


Sua missão

Planejar e garantir o fluxo contínuo e eficiente da produção, aplicando os princípios do Lean Manufacturing, assegurando o abastecimento das linhas produtivas e o cumprimento de prazos e padrões regulatórios.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar no planejamento da produção com base na demanda, capacidade produtiva e disponibilidade de materiais.
  • Garantir o controle de estoques, com parametrização e revisão de dados mestres no sistema.
  • Elaborar e sequenciar planos de produção de curto e médio prazo.
  • Participar do processo de S&OP e de análises de capacidade produtiva.
  • Apoiar o nivelamento de produção (Heijunka) e a eficiência das linhas.
  • Emitir, liberar e acompanhar ordens de produção, atuando preventivamente diante de desvios.
  • Monitorar todo o ciclo produtivo, assegurando o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF).
  • Aplicar ferramentas Lean: Kanban, 5S, gestão visual, Kaizen, fluxos puxados etc.
  • Participar de projetos Kaizen e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Acompanhar reuniões diárias e KPIs como aderência ao plano, OEE e lead time.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas como Produção, Qualidade, Engenharia e Suprimentos.
  • Assegurar conformidade com as normas da ANVISA e requisitos regulatórios da indústria farmacêutica.


O que buscamos

title: Analista de Produtos Sênior - Seguro de Vida
description:
Sobre a MAPFRE


Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? Atuar na análise, evolução e melhoria contínua dos produtos de seguros de pessoas, conduzindo estudos de desempenho, propondo soluções técnicas e operacionais, e colaborando com áreas internas para garantir a eficiência dos processos e a competitividade frente ao mercado.   • Liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento e manutenção de produtos de vida individual e coletivo.

  • Analisar o desempenho dos produtos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria com base na avaliação de indicadores e dados quantitativos.

  • Conduzir benchmarking e análises de mercado dos produtos de vida individual e coletivo.
  • Apoiar a gestão de contratos e relacionamento com áreas parceiras.


O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ:


  • Ensino Superior completo (preferencialmente em Ciências Atuariais, Estatística, Economia, Matemática ou Administração).
  • Experiência sólida em produtos de seguros de vida.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Excel, PowerPoint e ferramentas de análise (SAS, SQL, etc.).


Local de trabalho: SÃO PAULO / SP (3X2)


Nossos benefícios para você


A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.


Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. Mais do que apoiar, celebramos cada conquista! Confira nossas ações para promover desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional e pessoal:

Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;

Mobilidade funcional e geográfica;

Projetos de voluntariado corporativo;

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, analisar indicadores de desempenho e promover o desenvolvimento da equipe.

title: Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil
description:
A função

A Kaleido está em busca de um Líder Técnico de Digital Assets – Kaleido Brasil para nos representar como a face técnica do nosso negócio no país. Nesta posição sênior, você será responsável por conduzir ciclos complexos de pré-vendas, fortalecer o ecossistema de parceiros, impulsionar uma comunidade técnica vibrante e supervisionar as primeiras implementações de clientes. Você garantirá que os PoCs e as entregas iniciais em Kaleido/FireFly estabeleçam o padrão em segurança, conformidade e escala.


Sobre nós

A Kaleido oferece uma plataforma de próxima geração para construção e conexão com redes descentralizadas (ex.: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Canton) em nuvem e Kubernetes. Combinamos tecnologias open source e proprietárias para fornecer middleware, gestão de ativos digitais e soluções de custódia. Nossa plataforma permite que clientes criem casos de uso corporativos integrados a ecossistemas descentralizados e ativos digitais — seja em nosso SaaS ou em nuvens privadas.


Responsabilidades

Arquitetura de Soluções em Pré-Vendas

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery, delimitar escopos de soluções, realizar demonstrações, desenvolver PoCs e analisar RFPs; produzir propostas técnicas, estimativas e arquiteturas prontas para SOW.
  • Mapear requisitos regulatórios e de conformidade no Brasil (ex.: CVM 175, LGPD, controles do setor financeiro) para desenhos técnicos, boas práticas de segurança e runbooks.
  • Mitigar riscos em negociações com arquiteturas de referência, planos de migração e critérios de sucesso; acelerar a transição de PoC para produção.

Ecossistema de Parceiros e Alianças

  • Identificar, recrutar, integrar e capacitar parceiros.
  • Desenvolver programas de capacitação: currículo, laboratórios práticos, trilhas de certificação, ativos reutilizáveis (implementações de referência, blueprints Terraform/K8s, templates de contratos).
  • Conduzir iniciativas de co-sell e co-delivery com estratégias de GTM conjuntas e governança clara.

Comunidade Técnica e Evangelismo

  • Representar a Kaleido em meetups, conferências e universidades; liderar workshops, bootcamps e hackathons.
  • Publicar conteúdo técnico (blogs, tutoriais, apps de exemplo, arquiteturas de referência) e manter repositórios OSS demonstrando boas práticas de FireFly/EVM.
  • Formar uma rede de contribuidores e cultivar champions e maintainers locais.

Arquitetura e Acompanhamento das Primeiras Entregas

  • Orientar implementações referência em Kaleido/FireFly (EVM/Besu/Quorum), padrões de privacidade, troca de dados e integrações com sistemas bancários (APIs, eventos, ISO 20022).
  • Definir SLOs/SLIs, IaC (Terraform/Kubernetes), CI/CD, observabilidade e assegurar a transição suave para os times de entrega e sucesso do cliente.

Segurança e Padrões de Custódia

  • Projetar integrações seguras de gestão de chaves e custódia (HSM/KMS, MPC, cofres).
  • Aplicar modelagem de ameaças, auditoria e controles de privacidade em casos de uso regulados.

Feedback de Produto

  • Canalizar insights de mercado e parceiros para o roadmap global, defendendo padrões específicos do Brasil.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação/Engenharia (ou experiência equivalente).
  • 6+ anos em engenharia de software; 3+ anos em pré-vendas/soluções com clientes; 3+ anos em blockchain corporativo.
  • Experiência prática com EVM (Solidity, upgradeability, Hardhat/Foundry) e Kaleido/FireFly (ou frameworks similares de private-tx/data-exchange).
  • Conhecimento em padrões de integração com REST/gRPC, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, mensageria e ISO 20022; familiaridade com fluxos de liquidação (PIX/SPI/STR, DvP).
  • Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), AWS e/ou Azure.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders (executivos, vendas, produto, reguladores).
  • Fluência em português e inglês avançado; espanhol é um diferencial.


Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência no desenho de programas de capacitação de parceiros (trilhas de certificação, conteúdos, soluções conjuntas).
  • Conhecimento em Hyperledger Fabric e/ou R3 Corda.
  • Certificações de segurança ou nuvem (CISSP/CCSK, AWS/Azure, CKA/CKAD).
  • Experiência em palestras, publicação de conteúdo técnico ou contribuições ativas em OSS.


Diversidade e Inclusão

A Kaleido é comprometida em promover um ambiente inclusivo que celebre a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Valorizamos indivíduos de diferentes origens, culturas e experiências, e buscamos criar um espaço onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e apoiados. A Kaleido é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas qualificadas de todos os perfis a se candidatarem.

title: Jr. Risk & Markets Consultant
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Jr. Risk & Markets Consultant to join our Markets & Treasury Risk Team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).

If you are passionate about market risk analysis, data quality, and financial controls , and want to work at the core of risk management processes , this is the right opportunity for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Validate and reconcile financial market data used by front-office and risk teams (prices, volumes, rates, market variables).
  • Monitor, calculate, and report market risk metrics such as sensitivities (Greeks), exposures, Value at Risk (VaR) , and internal limits.
  • Perform variance and P&L analysis , comparing estimates vs. actual results to identify inconsistencies or potential risk events.
  • Support the creation and automation of risk reports and dashboards for decision-making by Risk and Treasury.
  • Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office to resolve discrepancies and ensure data integrity for risk models.
  • Assist in the development of scripts or tools for risk data validation and control automation (Python, SQL, R).
  • Participate in data integrity tests , stress scenarios, and contribute to internal control and compliance processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics , or related fields.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical foundation, with solid knowledge of probability, statistics, and numerical methods .
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data validation).
  • Basic programming or scripting skills (Python, R, SQL, or similar ) applied to risk or data analysis.
  • Advanced Spanish or English (daily communication with LATAM stakeholders).
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and rigorous when working with large financial datasets .
  • 1 to 3 years of experience (internship or full-time) in risk, market analysis, or financial environments .


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in market risk or related areas (trading desk support, risk control, or model validation).
  • Knowledge of derivatives, fixed income, FX, and interest rate products .
  • Familiarity with risk frameworks (VaR, stress testing, backtesting, sensitivity analysis).
  • Experience with Python analytical libraries (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Advanced English for global projects and documentation.
  • Certifications or training in FRM, CFA , or specific risk management programs.
  • Knowledge of BI / data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) and version control tools (Git).


What We Offer

  • Exposure to market risk management projects and strategic financial decision-making.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with leading financial institutions.
  • Continuous learning and official certifications (risk, technology, and finance).
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • A personalized development plan with mentorship and growth opportunities.


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR R$ 800,00
  • Free English and Spanish Lessons
  • Flexible work environment, internal events, travel opportunities, and wellness initiatives.

Seu desafio será ir além dos ciclos anuais de performance e dos planos de treinamento prontos, construindo um Ecossistema de Crescimento que maximize a capacidade e a evolução contínua dos nossos talentos, utilizando dados para comprovar o valor de cada intervenção.


O Que Você Vai Desenhar (As Principais Entregas):

Aqui, o seu trabalho é transformar o como fazemos Pessoas:

  1. Arquitetura Preditiva do Talento: Saia do R&S reativo. Você vai projetar o Talent Sourcing usando IA e análise preditiva para antecipar as necessidades de habilidades futuras , construindo comunidades de talentos antes que a necessidade bata à porta.
  2. Design da Experiência do Colaborador (EX): Ser o Head Designer de toda a jornada. Desde o prospect até o alumnus , você garantirá que cada interação reforce nossa cultura de alto impacto .
  3. Cultura de Crescimento Contínuo: Evoluir a Performance de "avaliação cíclica" para um Modelo em Tempo Real . Você irá equipar a liderança com ferramentas de Micro-Coaching para focarem na evolução diária das skills , não apenas na nota final.
  4. Ecossistema de Aprendizagem Líquida (LXP): Acabar com o "Plano Anual de T&D". Você desenhará um LXP Personalizado e Just-in-Time , usando dados para mapear Skill Gaps e prover upskilling e reskilling imediatos.
  5. Organização Baseada em Habilidades: Mudar o foco de "cargos" para "capacidades". Você substituirá a Matriz de Competências estática por um Mapa Dinâmico de Habilidades , desenhando sistemas de Mobilidade Interna para alocar talentos flexivelmente em projetos críticos.
  6. Consultoria em Design Organizacional (OD): Atuar como consultor estratégico para a alta liderança.


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Visão de Arquiteto e Pensamento Sistêmico: Você vê o RH como um sistema interconectado , e não como silos de R&S, T&D e DP.
  • Empatia Algorítmica: Você tem uma cultura analítica forte e usa dados (People Analytics Avançado ) não para controlar, mas para personalizar e humanizar a experiência em escala.
  • Storyteller de Dados: Sua habilidade em negociar e influenciar a alta liderança é superior, traduzindo insights complexos de dados em narrativas de impacto no negócio.
  • Inovação e Lean HR : Você tem coragem para experimentar com rapidez e baixa fidelidade (testar e aprender ) e abandonar o que não funciona (Gestão de Mudança).


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Seu Kit de Ferramentas):

  • Domínio de Design de Experiência do Colaborador (EX Design) e Design Thinking aplicados ao RH.
  • Conhecimento avançado em People Analytics (modelagem preditiva) e visualização de dados.
  • Proficiência em metodologias ágeis de Performance (OKR, Feedback Contínuo ) e Gestão de Mudança Organizacional (PROSCI ou similar) .
  • Conhecimento prático em Design Organizacional (OD) ou Organizational Network Analysis (ONA) é um grande diferencial .


Formação & Certificações Chave:

  • Diferencial de Vanguarda: Certificação em Organizational Design (OD) , Behavioral Science ou Coaching de Liderança .


Se você é uma pessoa que está pronta para ir além do operacional e desenhar o futuro da organização, queremos te conhecer. Candidate-se e venha construir nosso ecossistema de talentos.
